entries.title: 🐝 THE ENCHANTING TABLE HAS BEEN REFORGED 🐝
entries.body:
# 🐝 THE ENCHANTING TABLE HAS BEEN REFORGED 🐝

@everyone

Paradise Cove's entire custom enchantment system has been rebuilt from the ground up. 🍯

This is a brand new system - **427 custom enchants** across six rarities, an all-new **Souls** mechanic, new shops, scrolls, dust, stat trackers, and fresh menus and icons for everything.

⚠️ **Please read - this affects your gear** ⚠️

With the overhaul, **every old custom enchant on your gear is being retired.** The old enchants don't exist in the new system, so we're reimbursing every player for what they had. Nobody loses out.

**How to get reimbursed:**

> **1.** Open a ticket in #🎟️┃open-ticket 
> **2.** Send **screenshots of all your gear** - Armor, weapons, tools, anything with custom enchants on it.
> **3.** We'll **tally up your enchants by rarity** and hand you back **random enchant books** of the same rarities.

**Example:** a full armor set with 2 Fabled enchants on the helmet, 2 Fabled on the boots, and 5 Unique enchants in total would be reimbursed with **4 random Fabled books and 5 random Unique books.** Every enchant you owned is counted by its rarity.

**Why we did this:**

This isn't just a reshuffle - it's a lot more to chase, build, and play with:

> 🔹 **More grind, more content** - 427 enchants to hunt, level up, and combine.
> 🔹 **Real build choices** - Gear now has limited enchant slots (4, raisable to 8), so you actually choose what fits your playstyle instead of stacking everything.
> 🔹 **Brand new enchant perks** you've never seen on the server before.
> 🔹 **Souls** - a new mechanic where your strongest enchants run on souls you earn from your kills.

📖 **Learn the whole system before you dive in:**

👉 **[wiki.jarton.me/enchantments](https://wiki.jarton.me/enchantments/)** - Every enchant, Souls, scrolls, dust, the shops, and stat trackers, all explained.
👉  You can also view all changes in #⚙️┃change-log 

Get your screenshots in, open your ticket, and come build something new. ❤️

@⚙️ Server Updates 
@📣 Announcements

# 📖 "The Awakening" CHAPTER 1, NOW LIVE 📖

@everyone

The wait is over. After months of rebuilding from the ground up, **Chapter 1: The Awakening** is officially live on JartonMC. 🍯

This is the questline we've been teasing, and it's the way the journey was always meant to start.

### 🐝 **How to begin:**
Log in and see Jason!

### 📜 **What you're in for:**
A fully redesigned quest flow with no awkward gaps
Rewritten dialogue and story direction across every quest
Rewards that actually feel worth your time
A cleaner path into skills, dungeons, and the rest of the world
New polish on every NPC, objective, and interaction

### 🌿 **The story so far:**
You'll arrive in Paradise Cove to find familiar faces, though something feels off. Strange activity. Missing pieces. A growing sense that the Cove isn't as peaceful as it looks.

Help the townsfolk. Stand the walls with Silas. Uncover what's spreading beneath the surface.

This is Chapter 1. The first real step into everything that comes next. 🗺️

🐛 Found a bug? Drop it in #🐛┃bug-reports so we can squash it fast.
🎟️ Need a hand? Open a ticket in #🎟️┃open-ticket 

Genuinely, thank you for sticking with us while we cooked this one properly. We can't wait to see you all in the Cove. ❤️

### Join at:
🐝 **mc.jarton.me**
on Version 1.21.4

@📣 Announcements
@⚙️ Server Updates

entries.title: 📖 "THE AWAKENING" — CHAPTER 1 REVAMP 📖
entries.body:
## 📖 "THE AWAKENING" — CHAPTER 1 REVAMP 📖
@everyone 

We’ve been quiet about this one for a bit.

Behind the scenes, we’ve been putting a lot of time into reworking how the server actually *starts*— because first impressions matter more than anything, and we knew Chapter 1 needed to hit that standard.

**So instead of patching it piece by piece, we rebuilt it properly.**

## 📅 Releasing May 15

A lot of systems and characters have been rewritten entirely to make the world feel more connected and alive. NPCs now lead naturally into one another, quests build on previous events, and Chapter 1 now actually sets the tone for everything that comes after.

From helping townsfolk around the Cove…
To defending the walls alongside Silas…
To uncovering the deeper problems spreading beneath Paradise Cove…

**This chapter is meant to feel like the true beginning of your story.**

We know a lot of you have been waiting for quest content and progression updates for a long time, so genuinely — **thank you for sticking with us while we worked on this.**  ❤️

We’re incredibly excited to finally put this into your hands.

📖 **[Full Event Details & Questline Preview:](https://discord.gg/jartonmc?event=1501982733734510652)** 📖

*See you all on May 15.*

entries.title: Gear Conversions :minecraftbee:
entries.body:
# Gear Conversions :minecraftbee: 

All gear items have been converted to a new system. This means that gear is now even better and allows us to implement more gear in future with a fully customisable system!

- Gear is now split up into 5 categories (accessories - can fit anything, rings, bracelets, artifacts and amulets) - by default you have 1 of each slot available in /gear, more accessory slots can be earnt through /rankup!
- Gear now has better stat buffs which can be viewed directly inside the /gear menu
- Speaking to Andy in spawn will allow you to craft new gear and salvage old gear into nectar!
- Gear is now harder to come by in dungeons, and in its place gold is more common
- Dungeon mobs now have a rare chance to drop 'Dungeon souls' - these new items are used in gear forging with Andy

Unfortunately this does mean that **all old gear items no longer work** - Please **create a ticket** in #🎟️┃open-ticket  and ask a staff member to convert your old gear items to the new versions, and any gear that was lost in the old gear menu.

Thank you all for your continued support @📣 Announcements @⚙️ Server Updates

entries.title: 🐾 Pets Have Arrived to JartonMC! 🐾
entries.body:
# 🐾 Pets Have Arrived to JartonMC! 🐾

After a ton of work, we’re excited to finally introduce **Pets** to the server — a brand-new system built to grow with you over time.

You can obtain **Pet Eggs** in a few different ways:
> 🛒 Purchase them from the webstore ([click here](https://store.jarton.me/category/pets))
> 🎁 Find them in crates 
> ⚔️ Earn them through dungeon loot 

Once you have an egg, head to **Ivy** in the Pets area at spawn to begin incubation. Each rarity has its own hatch time — higher tiers take longer, but reward you with stronger, rarer companions.

**Every pet comes with unique stats:**
> ❤️ Regeneration  
> 💥 Damage  
> 🛡️ Resistance  
> ✨ Magic Ability  

Level up your pet by feeding it **Pet Candy**, granting XP as it grows.  
Want a serious power spike? Feed your pet **Pet Crystals** to gain a massive **+50% Damage** and **+50% Toughness** boost.

Pets are meant to be long-term companions, something you build, invest in, and grow alongside you on your journey.

We can’t wait to see what you hatch. 🐾
@everyone

# 🚨 IMPORTANT 🚨

## We’ll soon be switching over everyone’s UUIDs. Unfortunately, this means in-game player data won’t carry over automatically. **BUT**, to help prevent any item loss, we’re asking all players to log in as soon as possible and move anything you want to keep into a regular chest. This includes items in your /vault and ender chest, since those will not transfer. 

When done we ask everyone to create tickets by going to #🎟️┃open-ticket and creating an **Appeal** ticket sending screenshots of your:  **ranks, towns (including town rank & location), exp, Questline progress and BANK BALANCE** and any **other ownership data**.

We’ll also be running **multiple key drops** as a thank-you for your patience during this process. And if you notice you’re missing a significant amount of items afterward, just open a ticket with screenshots so we can help restore anything lost so please don’t stress.

**This does NOT include builds, ONLY playerdata and items**
## **This change will happen in 24 HOURS** - Please create your tickets as soon as possible to ensure you don't lose any of your progress.

We know this isn’t the kind of announcement anyone likes to hear, but we’re doing everything we can to make this transition smooth and fair for every player. Thank you for being patient, understanding, and part of our community. ❤️

entries.title: 📚 JartonMC Storyline 📚
entries.body:
# 📚 JartonMC Storyline 📚


JartonMC will have an extremely in-depth storyline with Interactive Quests, NPCs, and Objects. The storyline will take you through the liberation of Paradise Cove by completing dungeons with friends and exploring the endless world of resources. The storyline will provide a guided walkthrough of the server from start to finish, introducing players to core mechanics, unlockable features, and the evolving world around them.

> 🧭 **Interactive Quests:**
> Dialogue-rich missions with branching paths and lore-driven objectives

> 🧱 **Modular Dungeons: **
> Scalable challenges designed for solo or co-op play, each tied to the Cove’s liberation arc

> 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 **Dynamic NPCs & Objects:** 
> Every character and item serves a purpose—whether unlocking new zones, revealing secrets, or advancing the storyline

> 🌍 **Endless Exploration:**
> Resource-rich biomes, hidden relics, and evolving world events that reward curiosity and teamwork


**❓ Quest Functionality ❓**
I have been working all this past week to get the storyline system functioning and getting it made, right now we have a basic structure for our quests and I am starting to implement it now. 

**💡 Suggestions/Ideas 💡**
I am open to any and all suggestions or ideas for side quests or npcs,
if you want to share your ideas, give a little summary and ping me in #🪶┃suggestions 

# 👀 Sneak Peak 👀
@everyone

entries.title: HUGE ANNOUNCEMENT**
entries.body:
**HUGE ANNOUNCEMENT**

We are approaching our beta release! With that being said, we are looking to build up our discord audience in anticipation for it. 

To help with our goal we are introducing a competition! The player that gets the most invites from now until our beta release will be awarded with our **ULTRA** premium role! This role will include some great perks for the winner!

To check your invites, use *!invites* in #📡┃bot-commands.

This competition is open to current members as well as future members. Good luck everyone!

*— JartonMC Team*
